capabilities: Number headings hierarchically using a configurable format
Derive a number prefix from folder and file names
Renumber automatically while editing via auto-refresh
Rewrite vault links that point at renumbered headings
Configure numbering per note through a frontmatter property
extras: README explains why the plugin reads every note in the vault for link updating, since plugin review flags vault enumeration; documents known limitations, compatibility (desktop and mobile, minimum Obsidian 1.2.8), and states the plugin makes no network requests.
motivation: The author wrote it to make writing technical documentation easier, because inserting notes and editing content did not update all numbering references.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to number headings hierarchically or tie those numbers to a numbered folder/file structure, which technical documentation needs for print references.
summary: Heading numbering plugin that adds hierarchical numbers to headings, optionally prefixed by folder and file numbering, configured per note in frontmatter.
